original.host_boundary: Complete original selected Line methods, original cbook step functions/map, and original Path.__init__/_update_values/vertices/codes with actual float-array conversion and actual API shape check. Path rc is a read-only capability populated from original _Param defaults. Other Path methods, compiled _path algorithms, large-Line subslicing and nonidentity transforms are not executed. Short Line/Axes unit/Bbox hosts are inherited from accepted D39, but PathStorage is replaced by the real constructor/body rather than treated as evidence for native aliasing. Native String-or-None setters are observations, not an API freeze.

typed_boundaries.None: Original id12 native None reset remains complete source-only evidence; the typed setter carrier is String.
typed_boundaries.Path: Typed flat TickValues bridge borrows logical Path vertices. Native two-dimensional shape, physical strides/contiguity, codes/readonly/interpolation/simplification metadata and NumPy warning records remain source evidence, not typed general-Path or GUI warning contracts.
typed_boundaries.alias: Default is physically the same current cache.flat object, including empty. Steps own a distinct view. Real public TickValues writes test both directions and retained old generations; no fixture simulation of alias effects is supplied.
typed_boundaries.setup: Public plot_line is only the typed attachment bridge. Source initial Line constructor/recache precedes attachment. A single initial path recache and explicit initial stored view/dataLim/minpos seed express that controlled host; no later operation state is normalized. Private mark_drawn supplies only the native stale=False input where recorded.
typed_boundaries.queries: Before/after snapshots inspect private caches/path directly. Public processed/path getters are called only at the corresponding source operation or initial retained-handle capture.
typed_boundaries.events: Complete actual unit/recache stage observations are retained; no arbitrary public conversion callback or GUI event protocol is introduced.
typed_boundaries.numbers: All finite values, signed zero and infinities compare by bits. NaN compares by classification; native NaN payloads remain evidence.
typed_boundaries.lifecycle: Relim and unit-remap use real checked Scene operations. Source stored views and requests are observed without lazy get_xlim/get_ylim.
typed_boundaries.scope: No native full Path API, large-Line clip optimization, marker/rasterization/general nonidentity transform or ndarray layout compatibility claim.
